sidebar_desc.0:
### Create Project
Design applications from scratch. Set unique identities, versions, and metadata for the **Influent OS** ecosystem with guided steps.
sidebar_desc.1:
### Build Package
Package your work. Turn development folders into compressed `.iflapp` files ready for global distribution.
sidebar_desc.3:
### Settings
Tune the program engine. Control paths, language, appearance, and options stored in data/pm.data.
sidebar_desc.4:
### MoonFix Suite
Deep repair. Scan, detect, and fix inconsistencies in your packages. Ensure every asset and XML tag is correct.
sidebar_desc.5:
### About
Technical project details. GPL license, Qt framework, and the team behind **Package Maker**.

security_warning.title: Critical Security Warning
security_warning.heading: Disable Sandbox Protection
security_warning.subtitle: This action exposes your project to significant security risks
security_warning.intro: WARNING: Disabling the Secure Sandbox leaves your project without isolation protection. This means the code runs without security restrictions.
security_warning.risk_malware: • Malicious code execution: Third-party scripts could contain malware or ransomware.
security_warning.risk_access: • Unauthorized access: The project could read, modify, or delete system files without restrictions.
security_warning.risk_changes: • Uncontrolled changes: Critical system or project files could be altered without authorization.
security_warning.recommendation: Recommendation: Keep the Secure Sandbox enabled whenever you work with code from unverified sources, downloaded projects from the internet, or when you do not fully control the origin of every dependency.

about.description:
Package Maker is the definitive suite for the Influent OS ecosystem.

Designed to help developers create, build, and distribute applications efficiently.


It uses the FLARM (Fluthin Armadillo) engine to ensure integrity and security.
